title.narrative: Strengthening the work of ancestral authorities to defend and protect common goods

description.narrative: This initiative will promote processes of environmental education and "Community Light" led by ancestral authorities, communities and local women organisations as part of an environmental and collective rights strategy for the peoples in the region of the Zona Reina, in the department of Quiché. Its design is based in the experience of more than 10 years. During this period the community leaders and the partner have established a working alliance based on the principles of respect and recognition of the rights of the people, as well as support for the defence of natural resources within their territories and the provision of public services such as electricity. As a result, the partner has facilitated trainings inspired in the ecological approach with women, ancestral authorities and community leaders. The wider issues and shared challenges are around care of all natural resources, forests, food agriculture based on an agro-ecological approach, as well as the generation, transport and distribution of household electricity through the construction of micro-hydroelectric plants. The partner organised consultation processes. Targeted communities will be in the center of each activity in order to guarantee an integral and realistic restoration and protection of the gallery forests.
